_note: Result copy for The ENM Triangle. Edit any title/description/shareLine freely. Keep the zone keys exactly as-is — app.js looks them up by key. `description` is shown on screen (second person). `shareLine` is what gets copied to the clipboard (first person). The three `edge_*` zones each match a tolerance band near an edge midpoint: a roughly 50/50 split of two traits with the third near zero. `monogamous` is not a triangle zone — it's shown (with no dot plotted) when all three axis scores land near zero.
